description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL), measured on the x-axis, and BLEU score, measured on the y-axis, for four different model variants evaluated in the context of simultaneous machine translation. The x-axis spans from approximately 2.0 to 11.0 with labeled ticks at 2.5, 5.0, 7.5, and 10.0, indicating a linear scale. The y-axis ranges from 25 to 33, with major gridlines and tick labels at every integer value, also on a linear scale. Four distinct lines are plotted: “Consistency-CE” (purple circles with dashed line) starts at BLEU ≈25.8 at AL=2.5 and rises to ≈31.0 at AL=10.0; “Inconsistency-CE” (maroon squares with dash-dot line) begins at BLEU ≈26.0 at AL=2.5 and increases to ≈31.5 at AL=10.0; “Inconsistency-CE-MP” (blue squares with dash-dot line) starts at BLEU ≈26.2 at AL=2.5 and climbs to ≈31.7 at AL=10.0; and “Consistency-Bi” (red stars with solid line) begins at BLEU ≈29.0 at AL=2.5 and rises steadily to ≈32.2 at AL=10.0. All lines show a positive trend, with “Consistency-Bi” consistently achieving the highest BLEU scores across all AL values, while “Consistency-CE” consistently scores the lowest among the four. A gray square labeled “BLEU” appears in the lower-left corner, likely serving as a legend key or annotation, though its specific purpose is not explained in the plot.
